labels.what: the audit of C_PL,5D (FD-CT-5B-AUDIT-DECLARATION.md), descriptive except for the stop condition; every number relative to each cell; P is the 5B readout's C_PL5D_rel, byte-pinned, rebuilt from the 5B unfolds as a control
labels.ov: OV(B) = sum_i min(lambda_i, u_i^T B u_i) / sum_i lambda_i on P's Euclidean modes: an upper bound on the share of P that duplicates B IF B's source caused the period offsets; it does not show that it did, and any broad normalization-like block, flux included, is expected to give a large OV (section 3.1)
labels.identification: weighted least squares of each g_X on (1, d), weights sigma_X^-2 (the committed per-cell noise sigma of g_X, diagonal): E_X = 1 - chi2_res(1, d) / chi2_res(1), a_X the coefficient on d in units of d's own 1 sigma; the intercept is free because a uniform offset cannot be attributed by shape; a uniform candidate is excluded
labels.replicas: P^(k): DESIGN section 2 on the k-th bootstrap replica of each period, each from its own seed block; one joint draw of the block's estimator under the data's resampling
labels.three_periods: the 68% interval of sigma_true / sigma_hat from chi2_nu at nu = (1 - V2)^2 / (V2 - 2 sum e^3 + V2^2), the Satterthwaite dof of the exposure-weighted spread; it depends only on e, so it is disclosed, not a stop clause
labels.ea_contrast: POST HOC: chosen after the 5B table showed R00 and R08 apart; descriptive
not_citable_for: the cause of a period difference, or which period is right
a validated size: a block built from the observed differences contains them by construction
the addition, which is its own declared step
